A full card image re-made by the Players Committee with the mark D-E1 in the lower border (12 November 2022). Its words are the Players Committee's errata for this card; Decipher published no errata text for it.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Hoth-L-21btooonebee-PC-Errata-D-E1-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with the printed card [[2-1B (Too-Onebee)]] (Decipher, November 1996): The whole card is drawn again at 745 × 1039 pixels: sharper art and frame, lore and game text set again, and the mark “D-E1” in the black lower border. The game text now reads: “Once per turn, one of your non-droid characters just lost from same site may be placed in your Used Pile. Subtracts 2 from X on your Bacta Tank.”

The whole earlier card image and the whole of this card image, both scaled to 500 pixels wide; nothing else is edited.
